highest_risk_false_optimization.what: deriving per-parent local top-W from SYSTEM-A's already-materialized global pool
highest_risk_false_optimization.why_tempting: local scores are provably identical to global scores by construction
highest_risk_false_optimization.why_wrong: A returns a globally ranked top-k; a chunk ranked 500th globally can be 3rd within its parent. Selecting from A's pool truncates to what A already found, which is exactly the set SYSTEM-E exists to go beyond.
highest_risk_false_optimization.predicted_damage: eliminates most of the 82.7 new union members/query and very likely un-rescues V2D-11, V2D-33, V2D-34, V2D-43
